details.note: Under construction as part of the Xinjiang-computing-for-Chongqing programme (疆算入渝). Construction formally began on 9 September 2026 after a start ceremony reported in December 2025; planned to enter service in June 2027. First phase designed for 100,000 AI accelerator cards in one 26,090 m² data-center building (construction tender, August 2026), to national Class A design. The accelerator and floor-area figures come from a directory description and are not confirmed by the news reports.
details.source: Xinhua, 2026-09-11; Chongqing Daily via CNR, 2026-09-11; Chongqing municipal government news, 2025-12-10; a commercial directory's facility description, citing the Chongqing government site
